summary: Completed testing of advanced coupon statistics and SMTP email sending features. All backend APIs working correctly (11/11 tests passed). Frontend Statistics tab displays all required components with proper styling.

issues: Shows 'No data yet' - expected behavior when no payment transactions with coupons exist

critical_code_review_comments: SMTP configuration is properly loaded from environment variables
Advanced statistics endpoint correctly aggregates data from payment_transactions and coupon_emails collections
Email sending uses SSL on port 465 as configured
Statistics tab UI has proper colored gradient cards (blue, green, purple, amber)
Top Used Coupons shows rank badges with gold/silver/bronze colors
Type Distribution shows percentage vs fixed counts with icons
Email Statistics shows sent/pending/failed with colored backgrounds
seed_data_creation: None - used existing coupons for testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Advanced coupon statistics and SMTP email sending fully tested. Backend endpoints: GET /api/coupons/statistics/advanced (returns summary, top_coupons, monthly_report, type_distribution, email_statistics), GET /api/coupons/statistics/usage-chart (returns 30 days chart data), POST /api/coupons/send-email (sends real email via SMTP). SMTP configured with gtxm1001.siteground.biz:465 using SSL.

GET /api/coupons/statistics/advanced.details: Returns summary (total_coupons, active_coupons, expired_coupons, total_usage, total_discounted_amount), top_coupons list with rank/usage/discount, monthly_report, type_distribution (percentage/fixed), email_statistics (sent/pending/failed)

GET /api/coupons/statistics/usage-chart.details: Returns 30+ days of chart data with date, usage_count, discount_amount

POST /api/coupons/send-email.details: Sends real email via SMTP (gtxm1001.siteground.biz:465 SSL). Returns 200 on success, 404 for invalid coupon, 422 for missing email

statistics_tab.details: Tab navigation works, displays all statistics sections

summary_cards.details: 4 colored gradient cards: Total Coupons (blue), Active Coupons (green), Total Usage (purple), Total Discounted (amber)

top_used_coupons.details: Shows ranked list with gold/silver/bronze badges, coupon code, usage count, total discount

type_distribution.details: Shows percentage vs fixed counts with icons in colored circles

email_statistics.details: Shows sent (green), pending (yellow), failed (red) counts with icons

monthly_report.details: Table structure present, shows 'No data yet' when no transactions

send_email_dialog.details: Opens from table, shows coupon code/discount, has email/name fields, Send Email button works

mocked_apis.note: SMTP is configured with real credentials and sends actual emails
